result.topic_en: Calculation expressing four linear forms x_1,...,x_4 in variables z and s via parameters a,b,c,d and α, defining ξ = x_1+x_2+x_3+x_4 = p(s−z), and deriving a quadratic relation between the x_i (a quadric / cross-ratio condition) with coefficients λ_i, μ_i.
result.transcription:
$(\alpha+1)$ $z$ \quad $0 \; 1 \; \infty \; \alpha$
$-1$ $sz-z$ \quad $0\;\infty$
$z-\alpha$ \quad $0\;1$
$1$ $sz-(\alpha+1)z+\alpha$ \quad $\alpha\;\infty$
[-$(z-1)s-1$-] \quad $\alpha\;1$
$-(\alpha+1)z$

$(\alpha+1)z + a(s-z) = x_1 = (\alpha+1)s + (a-\alpha+1)(s-z)$ [?]
$-sz+z+b(s-z) = x_2 = -sz+s+(b-1)(s-z)$
$z-\alpha + c(s-z) = x_3$
$sz-(\alpha+1)z+\alpha+d(s-z) = x_4$
$\xi = x_1+x_2+x_3+x_4 = (a+b+c+d)(s-z) = p(s-z)$

$x_1 - \frac{a}{p}\xi$ \quad $x_1 - \frac{a-\alpha+1}{p}\xi$
$x_2 - \frac{b}{p}\xi$ \quad $x_2 - \frac{b-1}{p}\xi$
$x_3 - \frac{c}{p}\xi$ \quad $x_3 - \frac{c-1}{p}\xi$
$x_4 - \frac{d+1}{p}\xi$ {+$\mu_4$+} \quad $x_4 - \frac{d+\alpha}{p}\xi$ {+$\lambda_4$+}

$\lambda_2-\mu_2 = \lambda_3-\mu_3$
[-$\lambda_1-\mu_1 = \lambda_4$-]
$\lambda_2-\mu_2=\lambda_3-\mu_3 = \frac{1}{p}$
$\lambda_1-\mu_1 = \lambda_4-\mu_4 = \frac{\alpha-1}{p}$
$\lambda_1+\lambda_2+\mu_3+\mu_4 = 1$
$b = \frac{\lambda_2}{\lambda_2-\mu_2}$ \quad $\alpha-1 = \frac{\lambda_1-\mu_1}{\lambda_2-\mu_2}$
$c = \frac{\lambda_3}{\lambda_2-\mu_2}$
$a = \frac{\lambda_1}{\lambda_2-\mu_2}$
$d+1 = \frac{\mu_4}{\lambda_2-\mu_2}$

$\frac{x_2-\lambda_2\xi}{x_1-\lambda_1\xi} = \frac{1}{1-\alpha}(s-1)$
$\frac{x_4-\lambda_4\xi}{x_3-\lambda_3\xi} = s-1$

$(x_3-\lambda_3\xi)(x_2-\lambda_2\xi)(\alpha-1) + (x_1-\lambda_1\xi)(x_4-\lambda_4\xi) = 0$

$x_2x_3(\alpha-1) + x_1x_4 - \xi\big((\alpha-1)(\lambda_2x_3+\lambda_3x_2) + \lambda_4x_1+\lambda_1x_4\big)$
$+ \xi\xi(\lambda_2\lambda_3{+\alpha-1+} + \lambda_1\lambda_4)$

methods.what: Definition of four linear forms in z, s with parameters a,b,c,d and their sum ξ proportional to s−z
Relations between coefficients λ_i, μ_i of the two representations of each x_i
Ratios of shifted linear forms expressed in s
Elimination of s giving a quadratic relation (quadric) among x_1..x_4
